children.name: Kirkia acuminata Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is Tanzania to S. Africa. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Kirkia burgeri Stannard
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Ethiopia to N. Somalia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kirkia dewinteri Merxm. & Heine
children.description: Kirkia dewinteri is a small tree in the Kirkiaceae, endemic to the dry savanna of the Kaokoveld in Namibia.

children.name: Kirkia leandrii  Stannard
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Kirkia tenuifolia Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Ethiopia to C. & E. Kenya. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Kirkia wilmsii Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Northern Prov. to Eswatini. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
